services.name: The Captain's Table Dinner
services.desc: An evening of distinguished company, curated dining and compelling conversation awaits as our Director of Education hosts this exclusive gathering of members, patrons and friends of the museum. The Captain’s Table offers guests a seat among leaders and visionaries who are charting the future of Louisiana’s maritime heritage. Each installment features a notable speaker whose work illuminates the Gulf South’s rich nautical history and cultural legacy. The evening includes:-A refined dinner experience-Featured keynote presentation-Private reception with speaker-Exclusive campaign insights and impact update An evening of distinguished company, curated dining and compelling conversation awaits

services.name: Exhibits & Collections
services.desc: Explore the movement of ships across the globe in real time with the ShipTracks interactive exhibit. Visitors can follow modern commercial vessels, historic trade routes, and regional maritime traffic while learning how waterways continue to shape commerce, industry, and daily life along the Gulf Coast and beyond.
